typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	HEALTHLINK_DATASOURCE as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_DB as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_PWD as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_USER as string (),
	RPT_DATASOURCE as string (),
	RPT_DB as string (),
	RPT_PWD as string (),
	RPT_USER as string (),
	v_CntExistingMember as integer (),
	v_CntNewMember as integer (),
	v_CntNewMemberInserted as integer (),
	v_cntTotalMember as integer (),
	v_createUserID as integer (),
	v_fileDestination as string (),
	v_fileExists as boolean (),
	v_loadDate as timestamp (),
	v_logFileFolder as string (),
	v_logPackageScript as string (),
	v_log_EventDate as string (),
	v_memberSourceID as integer (),
	v_stratFileFolder as string (),
	v_stratFileName as string (),
	v_stratLevelSourceID as integer ()
}

source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT SBSB_ID   FROM  [APP_DMCCU].[TNHEALTHLINK_NONEXISTING_MEMBER] UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT 999999999 AS SBSB_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(dc_fileName = $v_stratFileName,
		dc_lodaDate = $v_log_EventDate) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		LoadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SBSB_ID as string,
		FileLoadedFrom as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LoadDate = dc_lodaDate,
		SBSB_ID,
		FileLoadedFrom = dc_fileName)) ~> FlatFileDestination
